accepted.quote: This approach is troubling for privacy. There is no clear policy rationale for granting broad access to health data that has essentially no direct link to payment of plan benefits, such as medical records, in order to perform oversight of plan service provider compensation.
accepted.rationale: The quote opposes broad sharing of health data and medical records for plan oversight on privacy grounds.
